namingRules.programCode: let actual=data.entity.fields.map(field=>field.defKey); let immutable=["t_email_otp_attempt","t_file_owner_ref","t_file_scan_result","t_document_delivery","t_webhook_event","t_audit_event","t_audit_event_attr","t_audit_integrity_point","t_security_event","t_security_alert_event","t_security_alert_action","t_integration_verify_run_step"].includes(data.entity.defKey); let custom=["t_gateway_route_header","t_gateway_route_query_param","t_gateway_guard_rule"].includes(data.entity.defKey); return custom ? !actual.includes('create_time') && !actual.includes('update_time') : actual.includes('create_time') && (immutable ? !actual.includes('update_time') : actual.includes('update_time'));

namingRules.programCode: let key=(data.field.defKey||'').toLowerCase(); let type=(data.field.type||data.field.dbType||'').toUpperCase(); if(key.endsWith('_date')){return type==='DATE';} if(key.endsWith('_time')||key.endsWith('_at')||key.endsWith('_from')||key.endsWith('_to')||key.endsWith('_until')){return type==='DATETIME' && parseInt(data.field.len)===6;} return true;
